description: This file defines the JobTitle entity class used in the ORM layer for the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the 'ohrm_job_title' table and includes properties such as id, job title name, description, notes, deletion status, and associated attachments and employees.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Entity class representing a job title in the HRM system, with properties for id, title name, description, notes, deletion status, related attachments, and employees.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the job title.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the job title.

methods.name: getJobTitleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the job title.

methods.name: setJobTitleName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job title.

methods.name: getJobDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the job.

methods.name: setJobDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the job.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the job title.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the job title.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the job title is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the job title as deleted or active.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Returns the associated job specification attachment object.

methods.name: setJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Associates a job specification attachment with this job title.
